messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
According to the UR10e manual, from what storage duration is a robot considered to be in long-term storage?

response.text: Secondo il manuale del UR10e, da quale durata di conservazione un robot è considerato in stoccaggio a lungo termine?
